featured_reviews.name: Raman Mishra
featured_reviews.review_text:
For short review, we would say that we were very happy with the work done by DesignAars (Aditya Sutar). They understood our vision perfectly and turned our house into a beautiful, comfortable home. The entire process was smooth, professional, and completed with great attention to detail with slight delay, which can be attributed to our side, their side and also due to market condition.
For those who wants to dig deep. We brought our small abode in 2022 and initially thought of doing the interiors/furniture after about a year or so due to budget constraints. However, it got delayed by almost two years due to medical exigencies and other reasons. We have prepared our list of things to do and were in the process of shortlisting a person who has experience and whose design language we could relate to. We might had gone over hundreds of videos on Instagram and YouTube, if not less. The name that caught our eyes was DesignAars. We casually went to his office once or twice, but were unable to meet Aditya (I didn't call him at that time, you may call it my laziness). Then we met him maybe after a period of 2 months and in the first meet I was sure that he is the one on whom I can bank on. He came, took the measurements and in a week or two gave a brief report of things we wanted to be done and the estimates for the same.
After the work was allotted to him, he finalized the designs after consultation with us. One thing I want to point out about Aditya is that he listens attentively to all your requirements and preferences and incorporates them into his designs. If something is not going in line with the design theme, he points it out and explains why the same cannot go with it. I am in a profession which sometimes don't allow me to take call most of the times, which I knew would be a handicap, but credit goes to Aditya, as he and my better half, managed everything without any fuss. I  have harassed the poor soul even on Sundays and late night (sorry Aditya for this) for tiles, laminates, door knobs, lights, bathroom fittings and other paraphernalia.
The living room, the kitchen, the bathrooms and the bedroom, all he has made a wonderful place to be in, each has its own unique charm. The work of the false ceiling is also top notch. The attention to detail in every nook and corner is simply remarkable. I fell in love with the intricate design patterns, color schemes and the clever storage space. Working with Aditya was an absolute pleasure. He is professional, reliable and goes above and beyond to exceed expectations. I don't think he has no in his vocabulary. He never says no to anything. He genuinely cares about his clients and their satisfaction, and it truly shows in his work. I wholeheartedly recommend Aditya and his Team.
